Thanks for the context — I can be flexible. Quick note on the mapping: CEST and CET differ by one hour only outside DST transitions, but in late June everyone should be on summer time (CEST). If your CTO's calendar is showing 09:30 CET that should translate to 09:30 CEST for June 24 (both will mean 07:30 UTC). That said calendar clients sometimes display the label 'CET' even when the timezone offset is +02:00.

Two asks from my side:
- If we prioritize the EU exec window, can we cut the session to 45m and cover the deep architecture Q&A in the first 20m so the CTO gets his highlights?
- Can Sofia mark the invite as "All times in CEST/EDT" and include UTC offsets in the calendar description to avoid the label confusion?

I can make Option B work if that helps; otherwise Option C gives us a little more breathing room.

—Aditya
